scripts.db:migrate: bash scripts/ensure-docker-deps.sh && bash -c 'export DEV_UID=$(id -u) DEV_GID=$(id -g); docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile setup run --rm migrate'
scripts.db:seed: bash scripts/ensure-docker-deps.sh && bash -c 'export DEV_UID=$(id -u) DEV_GID=$(id -g); docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile setup run --rm seed'
scripts.db:generate: bash scripts/ensure-docker-deps.sh && bash -c 'export DEV_UID=$(id -u) DEV_GID=$(id -g); docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile setup run --rm install sh -c "cd apps/api && npx prisma generate"'
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres && sleep 3 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: bash scripts/ensure-docker-deps.sh && bash -c 'export DEV_UID=$(id -u) DEV_GID=$(id -g); docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test' && npm run test:down
scripts.test:up: bash -c 'export DEV_UID=$(id -u) DEV_GID=$(id -g); docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait api-test'
scripts.test:watch: bash scripts/ensure-docker-deps.sh && bash -c 'export DEV_UID=$(id -u) DEV_GID=$(id -g); docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test npx jest --watch --coverage=false'
